name: im.binyan/binyan
title: Binyan.im · בניינים
description: Building committee (ועד בית) management: payments, expenses, bank matching, tickets, reports.

tools.name: create_building
tools.description: Create a new building for this ועד בית account.

name.description: Building name as it appears to residents.

currency.description: Currency for all money in this building. Defaults to ILS.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the building, for example Asia/Jerusalem. Defaults to UTC.

duesDueDay.description: Day of the month monthly dues are due, 1 to 28. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: add_apartment
tools.description: Add an apartment to a building in this ועד בית account.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

number.description: Apartment number or label as used on the door, for example "3" or "PH".

floor.description: Floor the apartment is on; 0 is the ground floor.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: update_tenant
tools.description: Replace the tenant contact on an apartment. This overwrites the current tenant.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

tenantPhone.description: Tenant phone number, including country code.

tenantEmail.description: Tenant email address; an empty string clears it.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: backup_building
tools.description: Exports the full building data as JSON that can be restored from the website settings page. Use before bulk changes. The response is the exact backup JSON the website restore accepts and can be large.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: list_buildings
tools.description: List the buildings this ועד בית account can open, with the caller's role in each one.

tools.name: list_apartments
tools.description: List apartments in a building. Contact details (email, phone) are left out unless includeContacts is true, and then only for callers who may manage that building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

includeContacts.description: Include tenant and owner email and phone. Default false. Only callers who may manage the building get contacts; others get only their own.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record money received from an apartment. Pass paymentId to settle an open request created by request_payment (the request is marked paid with the method, date and reference you give). Without paymentId it stands alone as a directly-paid payment, for money that arrived with no prior request. For a prepayment covering several months use record_prepayment. Pass cashBox true when the money went into the building cash box (CASH payments only; it defaults to true for CASH).

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

paymentId.description: UUID (or unique prefix) of an open payment request to settle. When given, the request is marked paid and amount, dueDate, type, startDate and endDate are taken from it.

amount.description: Amount paid, in the building currency. Required when not settling a request with paymentId.

dueDate.description: Due date of the payment. Required when not settling a request with paymentId.

type.description: Payment type: BUILDING_TAX, SPECIAL_COLLECTION, or OTHER. Required when not settling a request with paymentId.

description.description: Optional note shown on the ledger line.

paidDate.description: Date the payment was paid. Defaults to today in the building time zone when status is COMPLETED.

status.description: Payment status. The tool applies COMPLETED when this field is omitted.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used when marking the payment COMPLETED. Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER.

cashBox.description: True when the money went into the building cash box. Only meaningful for CASH payments; other methods ignore it. Defaults to true for CASH and false otherwise.

referenceNumber.description: Optional bank, cheque, card, or other transaction reference.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: record_offset
tools.description: Record a new resident-paid expense as a dues credit for one apartment (קיזוז). Creates the expense and a BUILDING_TAX credit in one step, applies the credit to the oldest unpaid dues and carries any surplus into the next month. No bank transaction is created and the offset is excluded from bank reconciliation. To offset an expense that already exists, use link_offset_to_expense.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

amount.description: Expense amount the resident paid, in the building currency.

date.description: Date the resident paid the expense. Defaults to today.

description.description: Expense description, e.g. roof door frame.

category.description: Expense category when creating a new expense. Defaults to Other.

vendor.description: Who was paid, when creating a new expense.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number, when creating a new expense.

referenceNumber.description: Bank or transaction reference for the offset.

cashBoxAmount.description: Part of the expense that was paid from the building cash box.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: record_refund
tools.description: Record money paid back to a resident as a debit on the apartment ledger. The refund first consumes the apartment open credit; any excess becomes an open charge from the refund date. BANK_TRANSFER refunds can be matched to an outgoing bank transaction, while CASH refunds come out of the cash box.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

amount.description: Refund amount, in the building currency.

date.description: Date of the refund. Defaults to today.

method.description: Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER. CASH refunds come out of the cash box.

referenceNumber.description: Bank or transaction reference for the refund.

description.description: Optional note shown on the ledger line.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: request_payment
tools.description: Record the committee's decision that an apartment must pay: creates an open payment request (PENDING) with an amount, a due date and the reason. Debt analysis, overdue tracking and reminders all run on open requests. When the money arrives, settle the request with record_payment (pass its paymentId) or mark_payment_paid.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

amount.description: Amount requested, in the building currency.

description.description: What the request is for; shown on the ledger line.

startDate.description: Whole-month coverage start, YYYY-MM. Any supplied day is normalized to the first day of its month.

endDate.description: Whole-month coverage end, YYYY-MM. Any supplied day is normalized to the last day of its month.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: record_ledger_adjustment
tools.description: Record a true manual adjustment on one apartment's ledger: a fine, a goodwill credit, a one-off bookkeeping correction. This is a journal entry with no payment lifecycle - it does not create a payment request, and record_payment does not settle it. To charge an apartment for something it must pay, use request_payment instead.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

amount.description: Charge amount, in the building currency.

date.description: Due date of the charge. Defaults to today.

description.description: What the charge is for; shown on the ledger line.

type.description: MANUAL_CHARGE adds a debit, MANUAL_CREDIT adds a positive adjustment. Defaults to MANUAL_CHARGE.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: get_apartment_ledger
tools.description: Chronological statement for one apartment with dues, manual charges, refunds, payments, offsets and manual credits plus a running balance. Residents can read their own apartment only.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

asOfDate.description: Only entries up to and including this date. Defaults to all entries.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: get_cash_box
tools.description: Cash box balance and movement list for a building: cash payments, cash expenses, cash refunds, explicit deposits and transfers between the cash box and the bank.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: record_cash_transfer
tools.description: Record a cash box deposit, a transfer from the cash box to the bank, a withdrawal from the bank to the cash box, or the cash box opening balance. Only the explicit bank transfers can be matched to a bank transaction.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

amount.description: Cash amount, in the building currency.

date.description: Date of the transfer. Defaults to today.

description.description: Optional note on the cash movement.

kind.description: DEPOSIT adds cash, TRANSFER_TO_BANK deposits cash into the bank, TRANSFER_FROM_BANK withdraws, OPENING_BALANCE sets the starting balance. Defaults to DEPOSIT.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: delete_offset
tools.description: Delete an offset payment and its credit. The linked expense stays. The action is audit logged.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

paymentId.description: UUID of the offset payment to delete.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: delete_ledger_entry
tools.description: Delete a refund, manual charge or manual credit from an apartment ledger. The action is audit logged.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

entryId.description: UUID of the ledger entry to delete.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: delete_cash_box_movement
tools.description: Delete an explicit cash box deposit or transfer. The action is audit logged.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

movementId.description: UUID of the cash box movement to delete.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: create_expense
tools.description: Record a building expense (הוצאה). A second call records another expense.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

amount.description: Expense amount, in the building currency.

category.description: Expense category, e.g. Cleaning, Elevator, Repairs.

cashBoxAmount.description: Part of the expense paid from the building cash box.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: record_prepayment
tools.description: Record a payment that covers several months up front (for example 5 months of dues). startDate and endDate name the covered months (YYYY-MM) and the debt calculation covers every month in that range. Defaults to status COMPLETED paid today.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

amount.description: Total amount paid, in the building currency.

startDate.description: First covered month, YYYY-MM (any day is normalized to the first). For a 5-month prepayment use startDate '2026-09' and endDate '2027-01'.

endDate.description: Last covered month, YYYY-MM (any day is normalized to the last day of the month).

dueDate.description: Due date of the payment. Defaults to the coverage start.

paidDate.description: Date the payment was paid. Defaults to today in the building time zone.

cashBox.description: True when the money went into the building cash box. Only meaningful for CASH; defaults to true for CASH and false otherwise.

referenceNumber.description: Optional bank, cheque, card, or other transaction reference.

description.description: Optional note shown on the ledger line.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: link_offset_to_expense
tools.description: Offset an existing expense against one apartment's dues (קיזוז): links the expense to a BUILDING_TAX credit, applies it to the oldest unpaid dues and carries any surplus into the next month. No bank transaction is created and the offset is excluded from bank reconciliation. To record a new expense and offset it in one step, use record_offset.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

expenseId.description: UUID of the existing expense to offset.

amount.description: Credit amount. Defaults to the expense amount.

date.description: Date the resident paid the expense. Defaults to the expense date.

referenceNumber.description: Bank or transaction reference for the offset.

cashBoxAmount.description: Part of the expense that was paid from the building cash box.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: mark_payment_paid
tools.description: Mark a payment as paid (COMPLETED). Generates a receipt number when needed. Defaults to paid today with BANK_TRANSFER; pass paymentMethod, paidDate, referenceNumber, and cashBox to record how the money arrived. paymentId accepts a full UUID or a unique prefix of one in this building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

paymentId.description: UUID of the payment, or a unique prefix of one in this building.

paidDate.description: Date the payment was paid. Defaults to today in the building time zone.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used. Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER.

referenceNumber.description: Bank, cheque, card, or other transaction reference.

cashBox.description: True when the money went into the building cash box. Only meaningful for CASH; defaults to true for CASH and false otherwise.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: cancel_payment
tools.description: Cancel a payment with a reason, which is stored on the payment and shown in the audit log and the apartment ledger. On an already-cancelled payment the reason can be set or changed. paymentId accepts a full UUID or a unique prefix of one in this building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

paymentId.description: UUID of the payment, or a unique prefix of one in this building.

cancelReason.description: Why the payment is cancelled. Stored on the payment and shown in the audit log and the apartment ledger. On an already-cancelled payment it can be set or changed on its own.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: reschedule_payment
tools.description: Move a payment to a new due date, and optionally change the months it covers. startDate and endDate cover whole months; when only one is supplied, the existing other bound is reused. paymentId accepts a full UUID or a unique prefix of one in this building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

paymentId.description: UUID of the payment, or a unique prefix of one in this building.

startDate.description: New coverage start; normalized to the first day of its month. When only one bound is supplied, the existing other bound is reused.

endDate.description: New coverage end; normalized to the last day of its month.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Update an existing building expense. Only supplied fields change. At least one of amount, description, date, category, vendor, or invoiceNumber is required. Pass null for vendor or invoiceNumber to clear it.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

expenseId.description: UUID of the expense to update.

amount.description: New amount, in the building currency.

invoiceNumber.description: New invoice number; null clears it.

cashBoxAmount.description: New amount paid from the building cash box.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: attach_expense_receipt
tools.description: Attach or replace the receipt or invoice file of an existing expense, and optionally set vendor and invoiceNumber. Send either fileBase64 with mimeType (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 3 MB) or an https url (up to 10 MB, public hosts only, no redirects). The file is stored like receipts uploaded in the app.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

expenseId.description: UUID of the expense to attach the receipt to.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded receipt file. Provide exactly one of fileBase64 or url.

mimeType.description: MIME type of fileBase64; required with it.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded receipt.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the receipt. Provide exactly one of fileBase64 or url.

vendor.description: Vendor override saved with the receipt.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number override saved with the receipt.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: analyze_debts_and_generate_reminders
tools.description: Analyze apartment debt. Monthly dues are due on the building's dues day (duesDueDay in building settings, 10 unless changed). asOfDate defaults to today in the building's time zone (timezone in building settings) and splits overdue from dueSoon. The response echoes timezone and dueDay. Reminders target overdue apartments unless includeDueSoon is true. The overdue total matches generate_financial_report outstanding and the dashboard pending collections.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

asOfDate.description: Debt cutoff date. Defaults to today.

includeDueSoon.description: Also include payments due soon, not only overdue.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: generate_financial_report
tools.description: Generate a financial report for a building. summary.outstanding is overdue debt as of endDate, from the same calculation as analyze_debts_and_generate_reminders. Monthly dues are due on the building's dues day (duesDueDay in building settings, 10 unless changed), so the current month is dueSoon until that day has passed. Dates follow the building's time zone.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: get_fund_balance
tools.description: כמה כסף יש בבנק, וכמה בסך הכול עם קופת המזומן. calculatedBalance is the bank opening balance plus payments received into the bank and cash deposited into the bank, minus expenses paid from the bank, bank refunds to residents and cash withdrawn from the bank, since the opening balance date. CASH payments placed in the cash box and the cash part of expenses are counted in the cash box instead, and offset settled parts of expenses are not subtracted. paymentsReceived never counts offsets; offsetCredits reports them separately and refundsPaid is the bank refund total (CASH refunds come out of the cash box). totalFunds is calculatedBalance plus the cash box balance, or null when no bank opening balance is set. Also returns the last bank-synced balance when an imported transaction includes a balance field; it is labeled separately and never added to the other figures.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: List payments (גבייה) for a building. Optional from and to dates filter the due date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

from.description: Only entries on or after this date.

to.description: Only entries on or before this date.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (הוצאות) for a building. Optional from and to dates filter the expense date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

from.description: Only entries on or after this date.

to.description: Only entries on or before this date.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: query_audit_history
tools.description: Read the change log for a building: who changed an apartment, a payment, or an expense.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

entityType.description: Filter to one entity type, e.g. Payment or Expense.

limit.description: Maximum audit rows to return. Defaults to 50.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: list_maintenance_tickets
tools.description: List maintenance tickets for a building, optionally filtered by status (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELLED)

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

status.description: Only tickets with this status. Defaults to all statuses.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: report_maintenance_issue
tools.description: Open a maintenance ticket for a building: a leak, a broken elevator, anything that needs fixing. Attach it to an apartment when the issue is inside one; omit the apartment for building-wide issues like the lobby or roof.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

apartmentId.description: Apartment UUID. Either apartmentId or apartmentNumber is required.

description.description: What is broken, where, and anything a contractor should know.

photoUrl.description: Public URL of a photo of the issue.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

apartmentNumber.description: Apartment number within the identified building, for example "3". Used when apartmentId is omitted.

tools.name: update_maintenance_status
tools.description: Move a maintenance ticket through its lifecycle: OPEN to IN_PROGRESS when work starts, DONE when fixed, CANCELLED when it turns out to be a non-issue.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: import_bank_statement
tools.description: Import a bank statement (JSON, PDF, DAT, CSV or Excel xlsx; base64, up to 3 MB). Skips exact duplicates (listed in duplicatesSkipped), imports but flags look-alikes with a different description (possibleDuplicates), records the balance the statement reports instead of importing balance lines as transactions, and returns the last bank-synced balance and the unmatched transactions. CSV and Excel statements must match a known bank layout (Hapoalim, Leumi, Discount, Mizrahi-Tefahot or generic headers); unrecognized formats and unknown layouts fail with an explicit "Unsupported statement format" error instead of importing nothing. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded bank statement file, up to 3 MB decoded.

filename.description: Original filename; the extension selects the parser (.json, .pdf, .csv, .dat, .xlsx).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the statement file.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: list_unmatched_transactions
tools.description: List pending bank transactions and their best payment or expense match candidates. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

limit.description: Maximum unmatched transactions to return. Defaults to 50.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: reconcile_transaction
tools.description: Match, create and match, or ignore a pending bank transaction. Matching to an existing payment marks it paid and replaces its paid date, method, and reference with the bank line. To match one bank transaction to several records, use action match with targets: [{ type, targetId, amount }]. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

transactionId.description: UUID of the bank transaction to reconcile.

action.description: match links the transaction to existing records, create records a new payment or expense from it, ignore marks it as not relevant.

type.description: Entity type for the match or create action.

targetId.description: UUID of the payment or expense to match; use targets instead for a split match.

targets.description: Split match: several payments and expenses for one bank transaction. Each amount is positive; payments count as money in, expenses as money out, and the total must equal the bank amount (e.g. bank -1020 = expense 1500 + payment 480 settled as an offset).

createFee.description: Also record the bank fee from the statement line as an expense.

payment.description: Payment details for the create action.

expense.description: Expense details for the create action.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: list_matched_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions already matched in a building, optionally between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD), with what each one is matched to: the payment, expense, refund or cash transfer it covered, including every part of a split match. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

from.description: Inclusive start day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no lower bound.

to.description: Inclusive end day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no upper bound.

limit.description: Maximum matched transactions to return. Defaults to 200.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

tools.name: unmatch_bank_transaction
tools.description: Undo a bank transaction match: removes its allocations and returns the transaction to pending so the match can be redone. The payment or expense itself is not changed; edit it separately if needed. The action is audit logged. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

transactionId.description: UUID of the matched bank transaction to unmatch.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.
